---
title: "Day 2 – Tools and the reproduction"
---
Day 2 is the day of the tools. It teaches R and the IDE on the data of the case, builds the analysis file from the raw files, and ends with a reproduction: each participant chooses one of the five reanalyses and reproduces the value that Multi100 recorded for it, with time to understand every line of the code that produced it. The five analysts worked on a person-month file that SCORE prepared and Multi100 handed out, which ships with the workspace. Each participant reproduces the value that Multi100 recorded for one of them, and then sets that file against the file built from the raw surveys, to see what the recorded values rest on.

| Session | What happens | Material |
|---|---|---|
| 1 – R and the IDE | Objects, data frames, the pipe, reading files and looking at them, in the IDE that you installed on day 1. | [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd), [your IDE](../../companion/ide.qmd) |
| 2 – From the raw files to the analysis file | Data management on the raw files: the first premarital cohabitations of the women in the two surveys, rebuilt from their union histories, and the person-month file on which the models of the paper are fitted. | [Data management](../../companion/data-management.qmd) |
| 3 – The reproduction | The five reanalyses and the choices that separate them; the reproduction of one of them, chosen by each participant, read line by line. | [The five reanalyses on the case study](../../cases/cohabitation/index.qmd#sec-reanalysts), [the exercise overview](../../cases/cohabitation/exercise.qmd), Task 3 of the workspace |
| 4 – The report | The reproduced value written up in the Quarto report of the workspace, with a short statement of what was reproduced and how, and sent to the class. | [Quarto and reproducible documents](../../companion/quarto.qmd) |

**By the end of the day** you can find your way around R and the IDE, you have built the analysis file of the case from the raw data, and you have reproduced one recorded result and written down how.
